_what: The shared full-setup progress and capability readiness. Capability requirements live in src/setup-policy.json and are checked through the saved workflow and current owners. Existing limited free access has separate explicit workspace readiness; it never becomes full setup proof. Optional computer permission diagnostics reuse current device reports and exact existing OS pane addresses. The existing AI picker and queued-work owner carry the whole setup to the person’s AI. Existing show-rules select setup requirements separately from full runtime verification. Operator rules and account-scoped setup-context can require native devices; personal rules change presentation only. Native installation prerequisites come from intact admitted workflow discovery and current device owners, never from a URL or a display rule. Requirements use one canonical projection, with capability progress in steps and necessary device actions in person_actions. A deliberately reduced admission cohort does not claim the full workflow finished. Setup does not lock the workspace; each operation retains its own authority and capability requirements. gate.read_every_seconds retains the shared guide refresh interval.
